recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,299.35 (+0.18%) and the Sensex at 81,911.01 (+0.04%); Bank Nifty moved +1.19%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +0.14%, mid caps (Midcap 150) +0.72%, small caps (Smallcap 250) +1.10%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹7,831 cr and DIIs net sellers of ₹6,331 cr (provisional, NSE).
Realty led the sectors (+4.51%), while Auto lagged (-1.02%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Gabriel India (+16.53%); biggest faller was Page Industries (-12.91%). Breadth: 296 advances vs 199 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.35% and the Nasdaq down 0.39%.
The rupee is at 94.03 per dollar, Brent at $95.62 (+3.08%) and gold at $3,922 (-1.96%).
